steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the combo or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: Hose routing
steps.body: Verify cold/hot hoses not reversed (4C2). Check detergent drawer pressure hose not folded or torn.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify cold/hot hoses not reversed (4C2). Check detergent drawer pressure hose not folded or torn.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Correct hose engagement and drawer hose routing.

steps.title: Smart Install valve tests
steps.body: Enter Smart Install manual check. Steps Co (cold) and Ho (hot) exercise inlet valves. Drum must be empty.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Enter Smart Install manual check. Steps Co (cold) and Ho (hot) exercise inlet valves. Drum must be empty.

steps.title: Continue to manual check
steps.body: Smart Install active. Continue below for component-specific checks.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Manual check mode — Start Manual mode advances steps per §4-3.

steps.title: Valves operate in manual check
steps.body: Do cold and hot valves open when commanded?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Do cold and hot valves open when commanded?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Verify taps open, screens clean; replace valve assembly.

steps.title: Fix hose routing
steps.oemOutcome: Correct hot/cold engagement and drawer hose.

steps.title: Check water supply
steps.oemOutcome: Open taps, clean mesh filters, verify pressure.
